summary: Numbered list (01, 02…) of forum discussions: clickable title, reply count, last activity (text or RelativeTime), optional tag, and a “New” indicator.
whenToUse: “Hot discussions” or “Recent questions” sidebar in a community portal.
Short thread lists where order matters (activity ranking, top of the week).
whenNotToUse: Posts with thumbnail and votes: use PostList.
Articles with cover and excerpt: use ArticleCard.
Long lists to filter or sort: use DataTable.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: When set, titles become headings of that level.

props.name: start
props.description: Number of the first item (also the list's native start), useful for pagination.

props.name: items[].time
props.description: Last activity: a Date becomes RelativeTime.

props.name: items[].replies
props.description: Reply count, formatted with Intl and pluralized (“84 replies”).

props.name: items[].isNew
props.description: Shows the “New” label next to the title.

props.name: isLoading
props.description: Replaces rows with a SkeletonList (aria-busy) while keeping the <ol> element.

inherits: HTML attributes of <ol> (id, aria-label, aria-labelledby, data-*).

keyboard.action: Moves from one discussion link to the next (and to any interactive tags).

accessibility: Ordered list <ol>: position is announced by the list; the visible two-digit numbers are decorative (aria-hidden).
The title link covers the row (stretched link); the tag stays on top and clickable.
Name the list with aria-label or aria-labelledby pointing to the section title.
Replies are localized, pluralized text; RelativeTime exposes the exact date in datetime and title.
responsive: Fixed-width number, title, and metadata wrap: usable down to 320px.
Designed for sidebars and narrow columns; no frame — place it in a Card if needed.
customization: Tokens: --dc-font-family-mono for numbers, --dc-color-border-subtle for dashed dividers, --dc-color-accent-container for “New”.
commonMistakes: Writing the number in the title: numbering is automatic (use start to continue from a previous page).
Leaving the list unnamed when the section has a visible title: link it with aria-labelledby.
Formatting “84 replies” by hand: pass the number in replies.

limits: Numbers have at least two digits (01…99, then 100…).
